training_record_access: Property models fit all protocol training measurements; LM supervised exposure is budgeted to10000 derived questions; retrieval sees all and only protocol train measurements. Report different supervision exposures explicitly.
main_comparison: Same mixed-retrieval-trained adapter: condition vs structure retrieval, same4-card1536-token budget; three fixed seeds.

hypothesis.uncertainty: paired bootstrap10000 resamples of solutes, averaging seeds within solute;95%CI; report all seed directions
hypothesis.supported: Both minimum effects met; CI excludes zero in beneficial direction; all three seed directions beneficial. Otherwise report unsupported/uncertain without tuning final test.

secondary: All ranking, coverage, costs, text/structure/condition contrasts, no_temperature/no_solvent ablations and chemistry slices descriptive; no selective high-score reporting.
strict_evaluation: Both protocols share same global test solutes; strict training removes test scaffold matches. Different training size is disclosed.
final_test_policy: No inference/scoring until method/config/checkpoint/prompt/analysis freeze. Candidate4546-query common test view fixed independently of labels; all ranking questions, pair cap32per solute. No tune after test.
consistency: Fixed512 selected validation questions, equal pair/rank quotas, plus candidate-order/equivalent-isomeric-SMILES transformations; all invalids inconsistent. Final test counterpart selected by identical rule before freeze.

iteration.purpose: Evaluate preregistered condition matching under bounded tuning, after actual200step pilot and resource probes. No scoring-based hyperparameter sweep.
iteration.prior_code_corrections: artifacts/audit/smiles_matching_fix.json; callback_resume_fix.json; malformed choice schema rejection.
iteration.criterion: If condition retrieval fails joint validation targets, record failure before considering at most three justified method changes. Costs/consistency/applicability can support an honest negative-result study.
